declarations.name: exists_forwardCoeff_energy_variance
declarations.doc: Every full-positive source has a finite, nonnegative residual variance, with energy coefficient exactly the residue square plus that variance.

declarations.name: exists_forwardCoeff_energy_limit
declarations.doc: The critical weighted energy has an actual finite limit.

declarations.name: exists_forwardCoeff_critical_energy_le
declarations.doc: Full positivity bounds the critical weighted square energy of the literal forward coefficients by a single logarithm.

declarations.name: forwardCoeff_eq_sourceCoeff
declarations.doc: The two existing definitions use exactly the same truncated logarithm.

declarations.name: forwardCoeff_harmonic_mean
declarations.doc: Both coordinates of the actual logarithmic first mean equal the residue.

declarations.name: exists_abel_energy_majorant
declarations.doc: A logarithmic energy limit supplies its exact upper Abel constant.

declarations.name: norm_LSeries_sq_le_energy
declarations.doc: Weighted Cauchy--Schwarz on the literal Dirichlet series.

declarations.name: exists_re_sourceFiniteGaussianSum_energy_le
declarations.doc: Full positivity bounds the complete finite arithmetic quadratic uniformly in its length.

declarations.name: summable_reciprocal_square_weight
declarations.doc: Full positivity alone gives finite reciprocal coefficient energy at every real part strictly greater than one half.

declarations.name: summable_quotient_square_weight
declarations.doc: The literal quotient coefficients also have finite weighted square energy. Actual quotient mean values require a separate argument.

declarations.name: exists_reciprocal_mean_square
declarations.doc: For every fixed line right of one half, the actual literal reciprocal has mean square equal to its finite coefficient energy. Full positivity is the only arithmetic assumption.

markers.text: The remaining logarithmic energy uses the existing positive Abel bound.
